# Cedargrid Digital — current launch status

Updated 2026-11-03. **Launch is authorized by the owner, but has not yet been completed.** On November 3 the owner reported completed PayPal identity verification and instructed Codex to open payment settings, proceed to checkout testing and publish the products. Payment-provider connection and release prerequisites still need verification. The November 1 findings below retain their original evidence date; no paid transaction or acceptance of new legal terms is implied by the launch instruction.

Users should select that worksheet when printing the customer quote; other wide worksheets are not promised to fit one page.

## First-sales experiment — proposal only

Target independent residential cleaners and small cleaning teams already comfortable with spreadsheets. The specific problem is repeatable cost-based quoting, comparison of up to 25 proposed jobs and review of recorded actual costs. The reason to pay is a ready-to-use offline workflow, fictional example and customer quote sheet; generic formulas, ChatGPT and free sheets are credible alternatives. Do not imply unique AI capabilities or guaranteed profit.

Current primary seller asking-price examples reviewed November 1 (not evidence of sales):

| Alternative | Observed asking price | Comparison limit |
|---|---|---|
| [Vars Digital cleaning pricing/job costing](https://varsdigital.app/p/cleaning-business-pricing-and-job-costing/) | C$19 | Claims Excel/Sheets support; not independently tested |
| [BooksheetPro](https://www.booksheetpro.com/) | $19.99 calculator; $39.99 bundle | Currency not established from the reviewed page |
| [JobCostLabs](https://jobcostlabs.com/house-cleaning-price-calculator/) | Free web tool; $11.39 spreadsheet | Currency not established; genuine free competition |
| [Kernovia cleaning calculator](https://getkernovia.com/products/calculators/cleaning/) | $29 | Currency not established; desktop Excel focus |

Keep CAD29 as the existing price hypothesis; no price change is authorized. Once sale readiness and publication are approved, run a 14-day small pilot. Prepare one honest demonstration using fictional inputs and one clear limitations/compatibility explanation. Seek permission to share in relevant cleaning-operator communities; use the owner's existing legitimate network or permitted educational posts. No scraping, unsolicited bulk messages, fabricated reviews or paid ads. Distribution/public posts still require approval.

Track channel-tagged qualified product visits, checkout starts when available, paid orders, conversion (orders / qualified visits), actual gross CAD receipts, platform/processor deductions, refunds, chargebacks and time spent on support. Net proceeds = receipts minus actual deductions/refunds/chargebacks; operating profit also subtracts labor and other business costs. No assumed fee schedule or earnings forecast is used.

Decision gates are experimental thresholds, not sales forecasts: fewer than 30 qualified visits means distribution evidence is insufficient; improve the approved channel before interpreting conversion. At 100 qualified visits with no purchases, review price/value/compatibility with willing target users before more promotion. Three or more genuine paid users who can complete their first quote with manageable support is a reason for a limited continuation, not proof of a scalable business. Any calculation defect, failed delivery or misleading claim pauses promotion immediately. After one focused revision and another measured pilot without paid demand or useful adoption, stop expanding this product and evaluate alternatives separately.

## Buyer acceptance procedure — prepared, not executed

1. Confirm approved exact ZIP is saved, product state/price correct, processor connected and seller identity/contact/refund notices approved.
2. Obtain explicit scope for a temporary accessible visibility mode, one 100% test coupon and one test order; record the previous state and intended restoration. Invisible cannot demonstrate a normal buyer journey.
3. With an owner-approved tester, inspect the actual product/checkout information and submit only the authorized zero-charge order. Check confirmation, receipt, delivery email and download page. Download the ZIP and compare its size/hash with the manifest, then open the included instructions and workbooks.
4. Restore the agreed coupon/visibility state and verify it. Do not delete order records or assume a free order proves payment processing.
5. If required, authorize a separate provider-compliant real-payment test with a legitimate buyer; verify payment, fees, receipt and delivery. No self-payment, refund or charge is implicitly authorized.
6. Only after these gates pass, seek exact public-sale/storefront publication approval. Leave Inventory hidden.


## November 1 follow-up — support/refund policy draft

**Draft for owner review only; not published, not added to checkout and not an accepted legal agreement.** Proposed business commitments: a 14-day voluntary refund window and a two-business-day response target. These need owner approval and a verified monitored contact route before use. They are proposed service terms, not a statement that Ontario law mandates these specific periods.

### Proposed customer-facing text

**Cedargrid Digital — Support and Refunds**

For help with a purchase, use our store’s Contact page or the seller contact shown on your Payhip receipt. Include your order number, purchase email address and a short explanation. For a workbook issue, include your spreadsheet application and version. Please do not send passwords, payment-card details or confidential customer records.

We aim to respond within two business days, excluding weekends and Ontario public holidays. Support covers downloading, opening and using the supplied files as described. Custom spreadsheet development, bookkeeping, and tax or business advice are not included.

If the product does not meet your needs, contact us within 14 calendar days of purchase to request a refund. This voluntary refund offer applies even if you have downloaded the files. We also review duplicate charges, missing delivery, corrupted files and products that materially differ from their description. A corrected file or replacement may be offered as an alternative if you prefer it.

Approved refunds are returned through the original payment provider to the original payment method where supported. The provider controls when the credit appears; we cannot guarantee a bank settlement date. Your refund does not require you to waive a dispute or another legal right.

Nothing in this policy excludes or limits rights or remedies that applicable law gives you. Those rights may apply beyond our voluntary 14-day window.

### Basis and remaining checks

[Payhip’s official refund guidance](https://help.payhip.com/article/281-refund-request) directs buyers to the seller through receipt details or the store Contact page; the seller manages the policy. [Ontario’s returns and refunds guidance](https://www.ontario.ca/page/returns-exchanges-and-warranties-ontario) distinguishes a seller’s voluntary return policy from other consumer rights. This draft preserves that distinction without declaring which legal rules apply to every buyer.

The Contact form has not been submitted. Before relying on it, obtain separate approval for one clearly labelled test message, send it through the existing store form and have the owner confirm receipt in the monitored inbox. Form success alone would not prove email delivery. No promotional or customer message is authorized by this policy draft.

Payment Details was rechecked during this follow-up: both PayPal and Stripe still display Connect. No payment settings were changed. The builder tab remains available, but screenshots remain blocked while it is in the background or Chrome is not foregrounded; no visual pass is claimed.

Prepared listing-accuracy clarification for a future approved metadata update: describe editable service **hours and costs**, rather than preset service prices; state CAD-only operation and that validation used LibreOffice Calc with independent calculations, while native Microsoft Excel compatibility remains unverified. Do not claim Google Sheets/Numbers support. No listing description was changed during this follow-up.
